dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Irregular circular and semi-circular light-gray perimeters with soft-edged transitions into darker centers, particularly concentrated on the mid-lateral flank.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, high-intensity white punctate spots clustered along the dorsal ridge and lower posterior flank, interspersed with larger, low-intensity dark patches.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: A non-linear arrangement of five primary centroids on the mid-flank forming an irregular pentagonal cluster, with a secondary triangular formation of smaller blobs near the flipper insertion point.
